writes a line to the audit ledger through audit.record()
Versioned. Model and effort live in the registry, not in code.
Results cached by file sha256 plus prompt version.
stop_reason is checked. Refusal or failure goes to human review.

svg.text: audit.record() is the only writer, in the same transaction.
Denied attempts are written after the rollback.
One chain per case plus a SYSTEM chain.
A trigger blocks UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE.
Head hashes are also written to a checkpoint file.
Recompute every chain, report the first broken seq.
Reads documents, explains conflicts, drafts words. Never writes.
Scoping, duplicates, rules, date math, permissions, audit.
OPS proposes and commits. LEGAL approves or rejects.
Nothing is filed or sent. Drafts are DRAFT_NOT_SENT.
Every query is scoped by case_id. Unclear ownership is quarantined.
A value is verified only when code finds its quote in the source.
A rerun never edits or deletes a human decision.
